name: How do I prevent mold from returning around my windows after remediation?

mainEntity.name: How do I prevent mold from returning around my windows after remediation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent mold recurrence, address the source of moisture. Ensure proper ventilation, especially in humid rooms, and use exhaust fans. Keep indoor humidity levels below 60% using a dehumidifier if necessary. Regularly clean window sills and frames, and promptly repair any leaky seals or gaps in the window structure. Consider insulated windows to reduce condensation and ensure exterior drainage directs water away from your foundation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent mold by controlling moisture: improve ventilation, manage humidity, repair leaks, clean regularly, and address exterior drainage issues.
